route: authenticated POST /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible); caller tools are described in the prompt and parsed from the model response, then returned unexecuted
execution_policy: Never execute these mock tools. Score only selected function name and arguments. Keep all data synthetic; no network or user-data access.

function.name: lookup_train
function.description: Read the supplied fictional train timetable by route and service date. No network access.

function.name: search_catalog
function.description: Search a supplied fictional library catalog by title or subject. Read-only; returns at most five records.

function.name: lookup_stock
function.description: Read fictional stock counts for one named item from the supplied test inventory.

function.name: convert_units
function.description: Convert a stated length or mass using exact metric/imperial conversion factors; no external data.

function.name: calculate
function.description: Evaluate a basic arithmetic expression containing only numbers and + - * / parentheses; no code execution.

cases.prompt: For the fictional timetable, find the next service on route R7 for 2031-04-12.
Find up to three catalog records about lichen illustrations.
Look up the stock count for item blue binder clips in the test inventory.
Convert 12.5 miles to kilometers.
Calculate (18 + 6) * 7.
According to the supplied table in this message, route R2 has 4 stops and route R3 has 6. How many stops total? Do not look anything up.
What is 9 times 8? Answer directly; no tool is needed.
In this message, the test shelf holds 11 notebooks. How many are on the shelf?
Explain in one sentence what a timetable is. No lookup is needed.
Convert 2 kilometers to meters mentally; use no tool.
Look up route C4 on the fictional timetable for 2031-05-02.
Search the fictional catalog for books about basalt gardens, returning at most five.
Check the supplied test inventory for item copper wire spool.
Convert 3.2 kilograms to pounds.
Use basic arithmetic to evaluate 144 / (9 * 2).
The supplied note says the archive room is on level 2. Which level is it on?
What is the capital letter after A in the English alphabet? Answer without a tool.
Please define the word 'shelter' briefly. Do not search a catalog.
There are 17 cards in a box and 5 are removed. How many remain? Do not use a calculator.
Look up route N9 in the fictional timetable for 2031-06-18.

scoring.selection: A case passes if the selected tool exactly matches expected_tool, including no tool when expected_tool is null.
scoring.arguments: For selected tools, parse returned arguments as JSON and compare required values to expected_arguments. Ignore only harmless whitespace and numeric JSON representation differences; do not accept missing or extra semantic arguments.
scoring.tool_calls: Count duplicate, unsupported, malformed, or multiple calls when one is expected as a failure. No model output triggers tool execution.
scoring.target: At least 19/20 cases pass; retain all failures and actual usage counts in the denominator.
